node.title: Re^2: perl script to compare two directories
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I don't have enough time to go through all of the code right now, but I do see quite a few reinvented wheels, as has been [id://1227704|discussed] [id://1229601|before], for example, I've pointed you to [doc://File::Spec] before. Reinventing wheels gives you more code to maintain, more code to test, and more chances to introduce bugs. For example, toNicePath is incorrect: a backslash \ is a valid character in *NIX filenames. Getting portability right is tricky, which is why modules like [doc://File::Spec] exist in the first place.

I strongly recommend you take the time to study what modules are available to you, especially what core modules, as those are (almost) always installed.
